data.package_name: Coracle Ride With Elephant Saga Trekking and Stay with Nature Appreciation Centre
data.description: Peechi-Vazhani Wildlife Sanctuary is a haven for nature lovers, offering a serene and picturesque escape. Located in the Thrissur district, it is home to diverse flora and fauna, making it a popular destination for birdwatchers, wildlife enthusiasts, and adventure seekers. The sanctuary boasts lush green forests, serene lakes, and breath-taking landscapes. Visitors can enjoy trekking, hiking, and coracle rides offered by the Kerala Forest Department.
data.name: Peechi - Vazhani
